source.note: Kenney delivery box truck (FBX like car-sedan, car-van and the other kit cars, with Textures/colormap.png; the plan named the GLB member). Height 1.84 m puts it at the same scale as car-sedan (2.84 m long): the truck is 3.62 m long and 1.67 m wide. Stylized toy proportions from Kenney (a real light box truck is about 4.7-6 m long and 2.3-3 m tall). maxColors 40 so the colour map's white-to-lavender gradient splits the windows from the cab. White box with a red cab (indigo accent with a sky shade), distinct from the all-red sedan, white sports sedan, cream hatchback, yellow taxi, black/white police car, light-blue van and orange SUV; the source's green box is white here. The slatted rear roller door reads as stripes through the lower pair. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
